entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's a complete piece of junk and I'm not keeping it.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with the product. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference with how it works?

It's just garbage! The whole interface is so incredibly **confusing**. It's way too **hard to use**. I've read the **user manual** from cover to cover and it makes no sense. I **expected more** from a product that costs this much. I want my money back, now!
I understand your frustration. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine. Hold on. It's VF773-9012. You'd better not give me the runaround or I want to speak to your manager. I will light up your company on every review site on the internet.
I understand. Thank you for that number. One moment while I pull up your account... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, placed on December 16th. Let me just review our return policy.
Alright, thank you for holding. I've checked the policy, and it looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
Wait, really? You're just... taking it back? No fight?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll be issued a full refund.
Oh. Well... okay then. I appreciate that. That's a lot easier than I was expecting. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Will there be anything else today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
